reason: Lookups that read one oldest-first 1,000-row page of a kind and filtered it in Python now filter in SQL (find_entities, with the indexed browser automation projections and integer payload filters), and bounded views show the newest 1,000 rows in chronological order (list_latest_entities). The selection covers the store contract and the AST guard against new one-page lookups (test_row_horizon.py, test_storage.py); the chat image preview fallback and image history (test_row_horizon.py, test_history_content_fidelity.py); mission analysis attempts (test_execution_ai.py); runtime preparation and VPN profile de-duplication (test_automation_runtime.py); the scope-import list (test_scope_import.py); browser assessments, automation leases/commands/rules, companion approvals and conversation binding, research intercepts/site map/Intruder/Repeater/HAR, and browser workspace bootstrap and traffic (the five browser test files). Each regression test seeds 1,000 older rows in one bulk insert and fails on origin/main. The real-Core Playwright entry drives the production Browser workspace, assessment and research views against a Core built from this branch.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. harnesses.py and missions.py are owned by claude/harness-lifecycle and claude/mission-recovery and are unchanged here; chat.py startup/recovery scans and chat_subagents.py are unchanged. Two nodes are pre-existing failures on origin/main 4facf4a and are excluded by node selection: test_browser_companion.py::test_screenshot_tool_persists_owned_image_and_replays_without_recapture (its SimpleNamespace ChatService stand-in lacks _turn_history since #559) and test_history_content_fidelity.py::test_selected_context_survives_context_length_recovery (ChatHistoryConflict: chat turn cannot start from queued, #559 admission). test_browser_companion.py::test_real_chromium_capture_retains_fields_and_rejects_changed_document is excluded because it drives browser_companion_runtime against real Chromium, which this change does not touch. No frontend or native tests: no ui/ or Rust change and response shapes are unchanged. Mocked Playwright browser entries are excluded because a mocked API cannot observe a storage query change; only the real-Core browser entry is selected. test_chat.py and test_api.py are not selected: the one chat.py change is the image-preview lookup covered above, and the api.py changes are covered by test_scope_import.py and test_automation_runtime.py.
